post.description:
Manual Text Data Insertion:
- Accepts title and content in JSON body.
- Validates company_admin role in the JWT token.
- Stitches tenant company_id exclusively from JWT claims (ignores any frontend payload).
- Inserts into MongoDB company_records collection.
- Returns success message and inserted record ID.

CSV File Import & Column Mapping:
- Accepts an uploaded CSV file.
- Parses byte stream using pandas.
- Maps headers (e.g. 'Document Title' -> 'title', 'Body Content' -> 'content').
- Stretches and stamps every row with the admin's verified company_id and UTC timestamp.
- Executes bulk insert into MongoDB company_records collection.
- Returns total count of successfully imported records.
